package_metadata.name: unified-mathematical-methods
package_metadata.scope: One executable library for the admitted calculus methods and finite polynomial sum proofs, with explicit domains, method restrictions and replay of the selected reasoning.
package_metadata.precision_policy: Keep explicit little-o remainder orders. A lost leading coefficient or insufficient order leaves the question open.
package_metadata.exponent_domain_contract: Raw exponents retain their original domain. Numeric integer folding is allowed only after raw definedness under declared unrestricted real parameters and empty extra assumptions; running variables remain raw. Exact simplification follows the domain check.

primitive_transformation_contract.acceptance: exact original open D; all actual u derivative and table guards on D; raw c*uprime*K(u) defined on D; f equals that product; F=c*H(u) covers D; final derivative replay and exact Fprime=f
primitive_transformation_contract.search: At most four deterministic AST kernels, same Engine; replay never searches
primitive_transformation_contract.stationary_points: No nonzero-uprime, inverse or monotonicity requirement; constants remain per original D component

partial_bundle_contract.ordered_sequence: [i,j] means D_j(D_i(f)); every ordered sequence gets its own proof
partial_bundle_contract.common_coordinates: All output coordinates use declared scalar atoms s; a child running v is rebound to its named common coordinate.
partial_bundle_contract.source_scope: Original raw natural domain and stated conditions persist through every derivative order.
partial_bundle_contract.entailed_guards: Use the existing shared nonzero/root domain closure; keep raw domain separately, with no added assumptions.
partial_bundle_contract.completion: All requested components require exact child replay and whole-original-domain coverage. Stop at the first pending component; no joint differentiability assertion.

package_metadata.expanded_nonzero_guard_powers: Fixed scalar known-factor/residual and exact power checks; powers1..8, nested-power and total-degree bounds512, direct bounded polynomial arithmetic, original raw guard admission preserved.

finite_parts_contract.argument: affine; slope must be nonzero on ALL original D
finite_parts_contract.method_certificate: Exact polynomial quotient, formal coefficient derivatives, existing table anti-cycle, complete raw finite terms and their guards; reconstruct before final derivative proof
finite_parts_contract.acceptance: Same Engine verifies Fprime=f on ALL original D; source holes and independent C_J are retained. Missing/altered parts recipe is rejected even for a correct final primitive.
finite_parts_contract.unsupported: Symbolic polynomial coefficients, unknown/zero slopes, non-affine kernel phases and log-power families remain pending.

package_metadata.derivative_scope_contract: Sufficient smooth guards must be strictly entailed by the original raw domain before clearing boundary obligations; original lists and included endpoints remain unchanged.

series_comparison_contract.source_scope: Raw finite/nonnegative terms at start and start+t for arbitrary fixed real t>0; no running variable in guard expressions.
series_comparison_contract.criteria: p>1 finite L>=0 implies convergence; p<=1 finite L>0 or +infinity implies divergence. p=0 is comparison with the constant series.
series_comparison_contract.optional_order: Only finite L>0 establishes a_n~L/n^p. Otherwise requested order remains pending. No series sum is computed.

package_metadata.scalar_real_power_sign_contract: New positivity guard: fixed scalar raw AST, at most48 nodes, raw definedness before positive sign; running-variable sign path unchanged. Normalized wrappers retain original raw-domain checking.

euler_contract.scaling: positive real t, all original X in conic D
euler_contract.degree: structural rational degree; coordinate names explicitly identified among scalar atoms
euler_contract.proof: all raw guard degrees certify cone invariance; nonempty witness checked without D assumptions; first partial bundle replayed; raw Euler sides defined on source-only D and exact equality
euler_contract.limitations: Coordinate constraints, unsupported symbolic nonzero-base exponents, unproved nonempty domains/boundaries or partial gaps stay pending. No joint differentiability inference.

symbolic_taylor_coefficients.notation: C[i](k) is row i at order k; A,B are the coefficient sequences listed in operands, in order. k>=1. P(A;k,j)=sum over ordered positive p1+...+pj=k of A(p1)*...*A(pj). An empty sum is 0; the term of degree 0 of any polynomial power uses the constant monomial 1. binom(r,j) is the falling factorial divided by j!.

steps.derivative_cycle: sum_{j=1}^k sign_j*function_j(A(0))*P(A;k,j)/j!, with (function_j,sign_j)=cycle[j modulo cycle length]

basic.sin: 0 for even j; (-1)^((j-1)/2)/j! for odd j
basic.cos: (-1)^(j/2)/j! for even j; 0 for odd j
basic.sinh: 0 for even j; 1/j! for odd j
basic.cosh: 1/j! for even j; 0 for odd j
